record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Prove that the series formed from intertwining operators and used to build higher-genus correlation functions actually converge, so that these series can define higher-genus correlation functions in rational conformal field theory.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2. Prove the convergence of these series obtained using intertwining operators to construct higher-genus correlation functions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setting. Let $V$ be a rational vertex operator algebra (so that $V$ satisfies the standard finiteness and semisimplicity hypotheses guaranteeing that its category of admissible modules is a modular tensor category). For irreducible $V$-modules $W_{i_1},\dots,W_{i_n}$ and appropriate fusion data, let $\mathcal{Y}_1,\mathcal{Y}_2,\dots$ denote intertwining operators among $V$-modules. To construct higher-genus chiral correlation functions on a compact Riemann surface $\Sigma$ of genus $g\ge 2$, one forms, via the sewing construction (gluing lower-genus surfaces along annular neighborhoods with sewing parameters $q_1,\dots,q_g$) and via multi $q$-traces of products of geometrically-modified intertwining operators, formal series of the schematic form
$$F(z_1,\dots,z_n;q_1,\dots,q_g) \;=\; \sum_{\substack{\text{intermediate}\\\text{modules}\,M}} \operatorname{Tr}_{M}\!\bigl(\,\mathcal{Y}_1(\,\cdot\,,z_1)\cdots \mathcal{Y}_n(\,\cdot\,,z_n)\,o_1(q_1)\cdots o_g(q_g)\bigr),$$
where the sum runs over a complete set of irreducible $V$-modules at each sewn handle and the operators $o_j(q_j)$ implement the sewing in the $j$-th handle.

Problem. Prove that, for every rational vertex operator algebra $V$ and every choice of intertwining operators and sewing data as above, the formal series $F(z_1,\dots,z_n;q_1,\dots,q_g)$ converges absolutely on a suitable nonempty open domain of insertion points $(z_1,\dots,z_n)$ and sewing parameters $(q_1,\dots,q_g)$, and that the resulting analytic functions admit single-valued analytic extensions defining higher-genus chiral correlation functions of the rational conformal field theory associated to $V$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent surveys (Huang, "Convergence in conformal field theory", 2022, and "Representation theory of vertex operator algebras and conformal field theories", 2020) explicitly identify the convergence of multi-$q$-traces of products of geometrically-modified intertwining operators as the main remaining open problem in the mathematical construction of higher-genus chiral rational CFT. The genus-zero and genus-one analogues are known, but the higher-genus convergence is still a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Convergence in conformal field theory (Huang, 2022)
status_evidence.snippet: The main unsolved problem in constructing higher-genus rational chiral conformal field theories is a convergence problem similar to the convergence problem for products and iterates of intertwining operators...
status_evidence.claim: Higher-genus convergence remains the main open problem.

status_evidence.title: Convergence in Conformal Field Theory, Chinese Annals of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Higher-genus convergence results... main open problem in constructing chiral higher-genus rational conformal field theories is the convergence of multi q-traces of products of geometrically-modified intertwining operators.
status_evidence.claim: Problem stated as still open as of 2022.
